title: Deferred revenue rollforward by customer tied to the GL
prompt: Roll forward deferred revenue by customer for the last closed month (opening, billed, recognized, closing) and tie the total to the GL.

setup.q: Which GL accounts hold deferred revenue?

inputs.name: Revenue recognition waterfall and contract balances
Invoices and AR aging for the month
General ledger for the deferred revenue accounts

steps: pull the revenue recognition waterfall and contract balances for the month, and the invoices billed in the month by customer
run rollforward by customer: opening, billed (additions), recognized (reductions), closing
pull the general ledger for deferredRevenueAccounts and compare the closing total with the ending balance
flag customers whose closing deferred balance is a prepayment while they also carry open AR, and customers in the GL with no contract
write the workbook with the rollforward on the Detail sheet and a totals row

done.text: Every customer row rolls forward (opening + billed − recognized = closing) and the totals row equals the column sums
The closing total equals the deferred revenue accounts' ending balance in Dime's general ledger for the period
Every exception row cites the customer id and the contract or invoice id
deferred-revenue-rollforward.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
Customers holding a prepayment while they also have open AR are flagged with both figures; a difference between the rollforward and the GL is listed, never plugged
